item.title: Thomas Marin: Discovered in the National Archives
item.description: Thomas Marin’s story illustrates how systematic archival research can uncover victims who have been missing from official counts for over a century. The Discovery While reviewing National Archives records related to Eastland claims, I discovered documentation for Thomas Marin—a victim who does not appear in any of the established digital databases or death lists that have been maintained for decades. Why This Matters The commercial “844” death toll that has been branded and marketed by heritage organizations is demonstrably incomplete.
